in_marathi.name: Shikhalekha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shikhalekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikha' meaning 'hair' and 'Lekha' meaning 'written'. It is believed that the person named Shikhalekha is blessed with knowledge and wisdom. They are learned and scholarly individuals.
